'''3464''' was a [[B1-series battle droid]] that served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as part of a [[Geonosian droid army|droid army]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]].<ref name="Episode II" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[B-series battle droid]] was among those deployed to the [[Petranaki Arena]] to [[First Battle of Geonosis|combat]] a [[Jedi assault team]] that had infiltrated the arena to rescue three [[prisoner]]s due for [[Death|execution]]: [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Episode II" />

As fighting broke out on the floor of the arena, 3464 and another [[battle droid]] approached a [[Jedi]] from behind on a walkway in the arena's stands. However, before 3464 could fire its [[E-5 blaster rifle]], the Jedi<ref name="Episode II" /> [[Sar Labooda]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> leapt from a doorway and cut down the [[droid]] beside 3464 before slicing through 3464 itself and destroying it.<ref name="Episode II" /> 3464 was rust [[Color|brown]] in color,<ref name="Color" /> standing 1.93 [[meter]]s tall and weighing 65 [[kilogram]]s.<ref name="Size" /> It was equipped with a [[comlink booster pack]] with it designation imprinted on the back in [[Trade Federation Script]].<ref name="Episode II" />

==Behind the scenes==
3464 appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. The droid's designation was not spoken in the film but was visible on its back.<ref name="Episode II" />
